main_body: Flat paving patch of stone slabs with darker mortar joints, laid as a ground surface (4x3 tiles); no standing volume.
top_band: none - flat ground paving pattern, no standing object; rows are brick-like slabs of tan-grey with dark joints
evidence: Terrain ground tile: a flat paving surface seen from above with a running-bond slab pattern. It is not a standing object, so the top/front contract does not apply; no side faces or elevation drawing. Terrain kind matches.

style.evidence: The slabs are large flat fills of one tan-grey (about 8x7 px or more) with only a lone highlight at the top-left of each slab and a small darker square patch. Joints are a dark purple-brown, tinted rather than black, and fine. There are only about 3-4 tones (base, highlight, joint, dark joint), against the reference paving with its per-stone cobble speckle, highlighted edges and 5-6 steps. Tiles are mostly 2-4 colours, so density is much lower than the reference, and the repeated identical slabs look like a stamped pattern.
